mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lms.tb_test ( sub_seq, test_name, duration, start_time, end_time, status, reg_id, reg_date ) VALUES ( #{subSeq}, #{testName}, #{duration}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{regId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT test_seq, sub_seq, test_name, duration, start_time, end_time, status, reg_id, reg_date, update_id, update_date FROM lms.tb_test WHERE sub_seq = #{subSeq} AND status = 'A' ORDER BY test_seq DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE lms.tb_test SET test_name = #{testName}, duration = #{duration}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_id = #{updateId}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE test_seq = #{testSeq}
UPDATE lms.tb_test SET status = #{status}, update_id = #{updateId}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE test_seq = #{testSeq} AND status != 'D'
mapper.select: SELECT t.test_seq, s.sub_seq, s.sub_name, t.test_name, t.duration, tr.total_score, tr.status AS result_status, t.status AS test_status FROM lms.tb_subject s INNER JOIN lms.tb_test t ON s.sub_seq = t.sub_seq LEFT JOIN lms.tb_test_result tr ON t.test_seq = tr.test_seq AND tr.account_seq = #{accountSeq} AND tr.status != 'D' WHERE s.cur_seq = #{curSeq} AND s.status != 'D' -- 과목이 삭제되지 않은 것 AND t.status != 'D' -- 시험이 삭제되지 않은 것 ORDER BY s.sub_seq ASC, t.reg_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lms.tb_test_result ( account_seq, test_seq, total_score, status, reg_date ) VALUES ( #{accountSeq}, #{testSeq}, #{totalScore}, #{resultStatus}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (account_seq, test_seq) DO UPDATE SET total_score = EXCLUDED.total_score, status = EXCLUDED.status, reg_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
